completeness.why: All five link functions now only do their provider-specific bank lookup and call linkBankSyncAccount, which owns upgrade-vs-insert, payee, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and the sync-event; the per-provider variations (fileId, insert fields, synced tables) are explicit arguments; the unreachable id==null check was simply dropped as dead code.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations (sync source, external id, new-row fields, optional fileId, synced tables), but newAccountFields is an untyped Record<string, unknown> and syncSource is widened with `| string`, loosening type safety somewhat.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copied link sequences are removed and replaced by calls to one helper; no residual reshaped copies remain.
